Resource Profile: EReferral Provenance

Official URL: https://fhir.doh.gov.ph/pheref/StructureDefinition/ereferral-provenance Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2026-11-26 Computable Name: ERefProvenance

Profile for tracking audit trail of eReferral actions including signatures and timestamps in the Philippine eReferral context.

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: EReferral ServiceRequest
  • Examples for this Profile: Provenance/ExampleERefProvenanceSubmission

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
